description.en: Multi-machine remote workspace: manage many SSH hosts, pick a local or remote workspace in the native Add-workspace flow (system folder chooser / local path / remote dir browse), mirror a remote workspace to a real local folder, and operate it with rw_* tools.
description.zh: 多机远程工作区：管理多台 SSH 主机，在原生「添加工作区」流程里选本机系统文件夹或远程目录，把远程工作区镜像成真实本地文件夹并用 rw_* 工具操作。
